portfolio_rules: This factory is historical evidence only and creates no new commercial work.
Existing artifacts and hashes remain preserved for provenance; publication, demand testing, and replacement SKU generation are not active objectives.
No paid-model/API budget or engineering capacity may be allocated to these SKUs by autonomous planning.
Verified engineering improvements to active projects outrank all former marketplace hypotheses.

skus.name: Quiz & Reward Engine
skus.buyer_problem: Creators need a drop-in quiz system with randomized questions, server-side answer validation and configurable rewards.
skus.reuse_source: Original implementation informed by generic quiz-engine lessons.
skus.reuse_boundary: No ABVM questions, school-specific content, Brookhaven material, private data or third-party runtime code.
skus.build_prompt: Retired historical SKU SKU-001. Do not build, publish, market, expand, or spend model/API budget on this commercial experiment. Preserve existing artifact evidence only.
